figurative_meaning_en: A virtuous person recognizes and associates with another virtuous person
similar_in_english: Birds of a feather flock together
example_sentences_in_bangla: রতনে রতন চেনে, তাই সে তার মতো গুণী লোকের সঙ্গে মিশে।
এই প্রবাদটি বোঝায় যে গুণবান ব্যক্তি অন্য গুণবানকে সহজেই চিনে ফেলে।
example_sentences_in_english: A gem recognizes a gem, so she prefers the company of equally talented friends.
This proverb illustrates how people of quality naturally gravitate towards each other.
history: This is a traditional Bengali proverb highlighting the natural affinity among individuals of similar character or talent.
note: The idiom draws from the metaphor of jewels to emphasize mutual recognition in virtuous circles.
